name: Booking a Hotel Room
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on booking a hotel room — practice these key phrases out loud:
I'd like to book a double room for three nights.
Does the room come with breakfast included?
What time is check-in and check-out?
Could I request a room with a view?
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
